properties.SQL:
INSERT INTO IDENTIFIER('${DESTINATION_TABLE_NAME}')
(
    KEY,
    PAYLOAD
)
WITH SOURCE_XML AS
(
    SELECT PARSE_XML('${flowfile_content}') AS XML_DOC
),
PARENT_XML AS
(
    SELECT XMLGET(
        XML_DOC,
        SPLIT_PART('${PAYLOAD_ARRAY_NAME}', '.', 1)
    ) AS PARENT_ELEMENT
    FROM SOURCE_XML
)
SELECT
    GET(
        XMLGET(
            F.VALUE,
            SPLIT_PART('${ARRAY_ID}', '.', 1)
        ),
        SPLIT_PART('${ARRAY_ID}', '.', 2)
    )::VARCHAR AS KEY,
    F.VALUE AS PAYLOAD
FROM PARENT_XML,
LATERAL FLATTEN(
    INPUT => GET(PARENT_ELEMENT, '$')
) F
WHERE GET(F.VALUE, '@')::VARCHAR =
      SPLIT_PART('${PAYLOAD_ARRAY_NAME}', '.', 2);

properties.SQL Query:
INSERT INTO QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.AUDIT_LOG
(
    RUN_ID,
    KEY,
    START_TIME,
    END_TIME,
    IS_SUCCESSFUL,
    ROW_COUNT,
    ERROR,
    ATTRIBUTES
)
SELECT 
    '${uuid}',
    '${KEY}',
    '${FLOW_START_TIME}',
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/Los_Angeles', 'UTC', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
    FALSE,
    NULL,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('${executesql.error.message:replaceAll("'","''")}',''),NULLIF(CONCAT('${invokehttp.java.exception.class:replaceAll("'","''")}',' : ','${invokehttp.java.exception.message:replaceAll("'","''")}'),':'),NULLIF('${error.message:replaceAll("'","''")}','')),
    PARSE_JSON(REPLACE('${JSONAttributes:replaceAll("'","''")}','\n','\\n'))

SELECT
    KEY,
    BASE_URL,
    COALESCE(WATERMARK,'2026-09-07T00:00:00Z') AS WATERMARK,
    ADDITIONAL_PARAMS:OFFSET_START::INT AS OFFSET,
    ADDITIONAL_PARAMS:PAGE_SIZE::INT AS PAGE_SIZE,
    ADDITIONAL_PARAMS:ARRAY_NAME::STRING AS ARRAY_NAME,
    ADDITIONAL_PARAMS:ARRAY_ID::STRING AS ARRAY_ID,
    ADDITIONAL_PARAMS:BATCH_SIZE::INT AS BATCH_SIZE,
    ADDITIONAL_PARAMS:FILE_FORMAT::STRING AS FILE_FORMAT,
    ADDITIONAL_PARAMS:DATA_TYPE::STRING AS DATA_TYPE,
    TO_CHAR(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/Los_Angeles', 'UTC', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),'YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SSZ') AS FLOW_START_TIME
FROM QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.CONTROL_API WHERE IS_ACTIVE;

properties.SQL:
INSERT INTO IDENTIFIER('${DESTINATION_TABLE_NAME}')
(
    KEY,
    PAYLOAD,
    INSERT_DATE
)
SELECT
    VALUE:KEY::VARCHAR,
    PARSE_JSON(VALUE:PAYLOAD),
    VALUE:INSERT_DATE::TIMESTAMP_LTZ
FROM TABLE(
    FLATTEN(
        INPUT => PARSE_JSON('${flowfile_content}')
    )
);

properties.CREATE_RAW_TABLE_SQL: CREATE TRANSIENT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.RAW_${KEY} (KEY VARCHAR(100), PAYLOAD VARIANT, INSERT_DATE TIMESTAMP_LTZ DEFAULT CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/Los_Angeles', 'UTC', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));
properties.COPY_INTO_SQL:
COPY INTO QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.TEMP_RAW_${KEY}(PAYLOAD)
FROM (
    SELECT 
        $1
    FROM @QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.API_LANDING/${KEY}/
)
FILE_FORMAT = (FORMAT_NAME = '${FILE_FORMAT}');
properties.UPDATE_WATERMARK_SQL: UPDATE QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.CONTROL_API SET WATERMARK = '${FLOW_START_TIME}' WHERE KEY = '${KEY}';
properties.INSERT_INTO_SQL:
INSERT INTO QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.RAW_${KEY}
    (RECORD, HEADER, RECORD_INDEX)
SELECT
    f.value,
    OBJECT_DELETE(r.PAYLOAD, '${PAYLOAD_ARRAY_NAME}'),
    f.index,
FROM QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.TEMP_RAW_${KEY} r,
LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => r.PAYLOAD:${PAYLOAD_ARRAY_NAME}) f;

properties.SQL Query:
INSERT INTO QUANTAS_AIRLINE_DB.SOURCE.AUDIT_LOG
(
    RUN_ID,
    KEY,
    START_TIME,
    END_TIME,
    IS_SUCCESSFUL,
    ROW_COUNT,
    ATTRIBUTES
)
WITH GET_COUNT AS
(
SELECT
	COUNT(1) AS TBL_COUNT
FROM ${DESTINATION_TABLE_NAME}
)
SELECT 
    '${FLOW_UUID}',
    '${KEY}',
    '${FLOW_START_TIME}',
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/Los_Angeles', 'UTC', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
    (CASE WHEN GET_COUNT.TBL_COUNT = ${TOTAL_RECORD_COUNT} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END),
    GET_COUNT.TBL_COUNT,
    PARSE_JSON(REPLACE('${JSONAttributes:replaceAll("'","''")}','\n','\\n'))
FROM GET_COUNT;
